recognize_zh: 這是多發性骨髓瘤 FISH 報告表格而非形態影像：del(13q14)、del(17p13)、t(4;14)、t(11;14)、t(14;16) 皆未檢出，唯一陽性為 1p32 缺失（CDKN2C）合併 1q21 擴增（CKS1B），見於 92% 細胞並標為高風險。
features: Tabulated multiple myeloma FISH panel report, not a morphologic image
Negative: del(13q14), del(17p13)/11q22, t(4;14) FGFR3::IGH, t(11;14) CCND1/MYEOV::IGH, t(14;16) IGH::MAF
Positive: 1p32.2 deletion (CDKN2C) with 1q21.3 amplification (CKS1B) in 92% of cells, flagged high risk
Additional findings: gain of ATM and TP53 loci in 85% of cells and trisomy 12 in 90% of cells, consistent with hyperdiploidy
Report advises correlation with clinical, morphologic and biochemical parameters
describe_en: This figure is a multiple myeloma FISH panel summary rather than a morphologic image. No 13q14 deletion, 17p13 (TP53) deletion or IGH translocations t(4;14), t(11;14) or t(14;16) were detected. The only abnormality in the targeted panel is concurrent 1p32 (CDKN2C) deletion and 1q21 (CKS1B) amplification in 92% of cells, with additional copy gains of ATM/TP53 loci and trisomy 12 supporting a hyperdiploid clone. Amplification of 1q (4 or more copies) together with 1p deletion is a high-risk lesion under current myeloma risk models, so this result upgrades the patient's cytogenetic risk despite the absence of IGH translocations.

ddx.vs: Hyperdiploidy alone without 1q gain/amplification, 1p deletion, del(17p) or high-risk IGH translocations is considered standard risk, whereas the 1p loss plus 1q amplification here confers high risk.
TP53 deletion would show loss of the 17p13 signal, but this panel shows no deletion and instead a gain of the TP53 locus, so the high-risk designation rests on chromosome 1 abnormalities.
